submitted.rationale: Zn-Sb-O line; ZnSb2O6 trirutile (Sb 0.667) is the expected photoactive phase. EQE scan: 0.503→0.42%, 0.577→0.79%, 0.611→0.85%, 0.643→0.45%, 0.758→0.09%. Peak lies in the Zn-rich trirutile region near Sb≈0.59–0.61; index 12 has the highest measured EQE.

rejected.reason: Sb-rich (0.758), EQE 0.09%, likely Sb oxide secondary phases
ZnO dissolves at pH 1.4; the trend falls off toward low Sb; not worth the budget
